topic: The Bending Path: Understanding Light Refraction

sections.title: The Hook: The Broken Straw Illusion
lecture_lines: Light normally travels in straight lines.
But watch what happens in water.
animations: Draw a straight line for the straw using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/straw.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Nature of Light Speed
lecture_lines: Light speed changes in different materials.
Air is fast, water is slower.
animations: Animate light pulse moving from vacuum to [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/glass.svg].

sections.title: The Physics of Refraction (Snell’s Law)
lecture_lines: Light slows and bends toward it.
animations: Draw an incident ray with label i in #FFD700.

sections.title: Real-World Application: Predator Precision
lecture_lines: Objects appear deeper than they are.
Aim lower to hit the target.
